rules.title: 18 credits, of which 6 credits must be from Group A and 12 credits from Group B
Economics courses with course numbers above ECON 208 (excluding ECON 295), at least 6 credits of which must be at the 300, 400 or 500 level
Only one of ECON 209 or the 6 credit combination of (ECON 332 and ECON 333) or (ECON 353 and ECON 354 can be credited to the Economics Minor
